# SymSpell English frequency dictionary notices

`frequency_dictionary_en_82_765.txt` is redistributed unchanged from the
SymSpell repository:

- Project: SymSpell
- Author: Wolf Garbe
- Source: <https://github.com/wolfgarbe/SymSpell/blob/c239062ae02961df18ab7da1671d01b4388204e0/SymSpell/frequency_dictionary_en_82_765.txt>
- Upstream revision: `c239062ae02961df18ab7da1671d01b4388204e0`

- SymSpell license: MIT; see `LICENSE-SYMSPELL.txt`.
- Local changes to the dictionary: none.

SymSpell documents that the dictionary was created by intersecting Google
Books Ngram frequency data with SCOWL (Spell Checking Oriented Word Lists),
then applying filters and truncating the result to approximately 80,000 words:
<https://github.com/wolfgarbe/SymSpell#frequency-dictionary>.
